Unarmed Security Officer – Casino & Hotel
Sentinel Protective Services · Las Vegas, NV

Patrol assigned areas, monitor CCTV, respond to incidents and write clear daily activity reports.

Requirements
- Active Nevada PILB security guard license (guard card)
- High school diploma or GED
- Must pass background check and drug test
- Strong report writing skills
- Ability to stand and walk for an 8-hour shift
- Availability for nights, weekends and holidays

Preferred
- CPR and first aid certification
- Prior military or law enforcement experience

We offer weekly pay, free uniforms, paid overtime, health benefits after 60 days and PTO.

Sentinel is an equal opportunity employer, including disability and veterans.
